name: free-form
description: A self-hostable, multi-modal markdown note & form engine web app and PWA

scripts.build:server: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.build:client: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=client
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.test:server: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace=server
scripts.test:client: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace=client
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
